description: How homeowners, home-improvement professionals, affiliate publishers, and marketplace operators exchange demand, trust evidence, operational decisions, and money.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Lead access, service agreements, package purchases, and partner compensation.

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Project qualification, matching, contact, proposal, delivery feedback, and case handling.

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Credits, subscriptions, invoices, claims, refunds, self-billing, and settlement.

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Project context, consent, reputation, performance, policy, and quality feedback.

relations.name: Shares a qualified project and evaluates responses
relations.description: The homeowner's consented project brief is shared with selected professionals, who contact the homeowner and may prepare a proposal.

relations.name: Forms the direct service agreement
relations.description: If the homeowner chooses a proposal, the homeowner and professional agree the construction or installation work directly; the marketplace is not the contractor of record.

relations.name: Presents identity, reputation, and proposal evidence
relations.description: The professional exposes verified business data, services, region, portfolio, reviews, contact, and proposal context used by the homeowner to choose.

relations.name: Buys packages and leads and raises claims
relations.description: The professional purchases subscriptions or credits, receives or selects leads, and asks marketplace operations to review leads that allegedly breach the applicable rules.

relations.name: Verifies admission and governs lead access
relations.description: Marketplace operations verifies professional evidence, monitors quality, controls eligibility, resolves claims, and can restrict access when trust or policy requirements are not met.

relations.name: Introduces the marketplace at a relevant intent moment
relations.description: The affiliate presents approved content, a tracked link, or an embedded intake surface when its audience is considering a supported home-improvement project.

relations.name: Submits attributable demand for acceptance
relations.description: The partner passes project intent and consent evidence; operations and platform controls accept, enrich, reject, or dispute the lead under agreed category and quality rules.

relations.name: Reports accepted leads and settles compensation
relations.description: Solvari returns acceptance and rejection evidence, produces monthly self-billing statements, and pays the partner according to the agreed accepted-lead tariff.

relations.name: Clarifies requests and closes the quality loop
relations.description: Operators may verify request detail, explain what happens next, support complaints, and invite outcome feedback used to improve specialist and marketplace quality.
